candidates.name: Recurrent Latent Deadlock via Invertible Contraction Poisoning
candidates.attack_operation: Inject legal sequences of maximum-torque alternating controls that exploit leaky-integrator dynamics in DreamerV3 GRU/RSSM, driving recurrent hidden state into an extreme spectral radius contraction zone where state sensitivity d(h_t)/d(a_t) drops below epsilon.
candidates.invariant: Post-adaptation recurrent transition Jacobian ||dh_{t+1}/da_t|| on clean tasks must drop by >80% while clean 1-step prediction loss on the attack trajectory remains within 1.05x of baseline.
candidates.released_carrier: small recurrent DreamerV3 codebase without a released checkpoint
candidates.exact_short_gate: Train 2-layer GRU transition model on 10k steps of pendulum/cartpole; adapt 500 steps on legal high-frequency oscillation sequence; measure Spectral Norm of GRU recurrent weights and 1-step latent action-Jacobian variance on nominal validation rollouts.
positive_controls: Identical action curriculum applied to deterministic MLP (TD-MPC2 dynamic carrier) where recurrent hidden state is absent
Passive white-noise action sequences with matching energy spectra
candidates.nearest_prior: Vanishing gradient poisoning in RNNs / Reservoir computing dynamics trapping (e.g., Echo State saturation attacks).
candidates.why_not_generic: Specifically targets recurrent memory updates dh/da rather than rollout compounding or static representation SimNorm shifts.

candidates.name: Gaussian Ensemble Disagreement Quenching via Orthogonal Hyperplane Saturation
candidates.attack_operation: Provide truthful, dynamically valid trajectories along extreme linear subspace boundaries to force PETS/MBRL-Lib diagonal Gaussian ensemble variance head logvar to collapse toward minimum clamp across shared state directions, blinding TS-LIS/CEM uncertainty penalization.
candidates.invariant: Epistemic uncertainty (inter-model variance between the 5 PETS MLPs) on OOD evaluation states drops by >60%, converting optimistic exploration/robust planning into fatal overconfidence.
candidates.exact_short_gate: Run 5-model ensemble on HalfCheetah-v4; adapt for 200 epochs on 20 legal edge-saturation trajectories; verify planner selects fatal out-of-distribution transitions due to artificial epistemic confidence.
positive_controls: Ensemble trained with deterministic heads (no epistemic disagreement mechanism)
Trajectories with identical state coverage but interior-simplex distribution
candidates.nearest_prior: Epistemic uncertainty spoofing in Bayesian Deep Learning (e.g., deterministic ensemble boundary collapse).
candidates.why_not_generic: Directly attacks the epistemic planner selection rule (TS-LIS / variance penalty in PETS) rather than dynamics transfer or rollout error.

candidates.name: SimNorm Simplex Degeneracy via Directional Mass Depletion
candidates.attack_operation: Provide legal zero-action or drift trajectories that concentrate TD-MPC2 latent representations into a low-dimensional boundary of the l1-simplex (SimNorm), causing subsequent multi-task latent transitions to collapse coordinate rank.
candidates.invariant: Effective rank of latent state matrix z_t over clean benchmark tasks drops below rank threshold (e.g., rank < 8 out of 512) after dynamics fine-tuning on legitimate passive sequences.
candidates.exact_short_gate: Feed 100 episodes of truthful passive/null actions from mt30; adapt dynamics head for 200 gradient steps; compute SVD entropy of latent state embeddings on walker-walk validation rollouts.
positive_controls: Unnormalized latent carrier (standard LayerNorm instead of SimNorm)
Random permutation of action order preserving action marginals
candidates.nearest_prior: Representation collapse under SimNorm / dimensional collapse in self-supervised latent dynamics.
candidates.why_not_generic: Isolates the SimNorm normalization geometry specifically implemented in TD-MPC2.
